seo.title: Daily Habit Schedule — Plan Every 30-Minute Slot | Momentum
seo.description: Momentum's daily view lays out your habits in 30-minute time slots from wake to sleep. Eliminate decision fatigue and know exactly what's next.
seo.keywords: daily habit schedule, 30 minute habit planner, daily routine planner, time blocking habits

hero.headline: Your day, planned to the half-hour.
hero.subline: Momentum lays out your habits in 30-minute slots from wake to sleep. No guessing, no decision fatigue — just follow the plan.

sections.heading: Time-blocked habits
sections.body: Instead of a vague list of things to do, Momentum slots each habit into a specific time window. This turns 'I should meditate' into 'I meditate at 07:00 for 30 minutes'. Research shows that implementation intentions — specifying when and where — dramatically increase follow-through.

sections.heading: From wake to sleep
sections.body: Your daily schedule runs from your configured wake time to sleep time, broken into 30-minute slots. Each slot shows what's scheduled, what's done, and what's coming next. It's your entire day on one screen.

sections.heading: Reduce decision fatigue
sections.body: Every decision you make throughout the day costs mental energy. By pre-scheduling your habits, you remove the need to decide 'what should I do now?' — freeing up willpower for the habits themselves.
